request.style: English, soulful female solo with gospel choir, piano, organ, electric guitar, drums, bass, uplifting and powerful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Companion raised his hand against his friends
Violated the covenant he made
Speech smoother than butter to the eye
War was hidden deep inside

[Pre-Chorus]
Words softer than oil on the tongue
Yet drawn swords were waiting there
They have no fear of God in their hearts
And they never change their ways

[Chorus]
Cast your burden on the LORD
He will sustain you forever
He will never let the righteous be shaken
When the trouble starts to grow

[Verse]
God will hear and humble them
Who are enthroned from of old
Men of blood and treachery
Will not live out half their days

[Chorus]
Cast your burden on the LORD
He will sustain you forever
He will never let the righteous be shaken
When the trouble starts to grow

[Bridge]
You will bring them down to the pit
To the place of destruction
But I will trust in you alone
In your endless protection

[Chorus]
Cast your burden on the LORD
He will sustain you forever
He will never let the righteous be shaken
When the trouble starts to grow

[Outro]
Cast your burden on the LORD
He will sustain you
